title: Witch Hat Atelier x Ascendance of a Bookworm Collaboration Reveals Trailer
content: The anime collaboration between Witch Hat Atelier and Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke revealed a special trailer. The collaboration was announced last month with a visual featuring the protagonists of both fantasy series .
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Confirms Disappointing Part 2 Update
content: Following the historic success of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle film, fans will finally get to watch it on streaming services. Ufotable announced a trilogy film series to adapt the manga’s most intense arc. So far, only the first installment has been released, and it ran in the theatres for almost a month.
author: ComicBook

title: Clevatess Season 2 Reveals New Key Visual and AMV Featuring "Male-bomb" by Static Dress
content: Clevatess Season 2 has revealed its third key visual, along with a new anime music video (AMV) featuring “Male-bomb” by Static Dress. As previously confirmed , the anime will premiere on July 8, with Crunchyroll streaming. Studio Lay-duce is returning to handle the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: HBO Max to Stream Live-Action Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights Series Internationally This Fall
content: The Junji Ito Masterpiece Collection panel revealed at Anime Expo on Friday Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights ( Strange -Itō Junji no Yoru mo Nemurenu Kimyō na Hanashi- ) , the live-action omnibus series based on 13 manga stories by Junji Ito , will stream on the HBO Max service internationally this…
author: ANN

title: TRIGGER Announces New Anime From Gurren Lagann, Kill la Kill, and Promare Duo Hiroyuki Imaishi & Kazuki Nakashima
content: Studio TRIGGER has officially announced its next flagship anime title, a brand-new anime project from director Hiroyuki Imaishi and screenwriter Kazuki Nakashima. This will be the duo’s fourth major collaboration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Suikoden: The Anime New Trailer Previews Theme Song by amazarashi, 1-Hour Premiere
content: Suikoden: The Anime , the anime adaptation of Suikoden II , revealed a new trailer and theme song by amazarashi. The anime was previously announced in March 2025 as an adaptation of Suikoden II , along with a new mobile game for the franchise.
author: Anime Corner

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists, New Promo Video (Updated)
content: Sony Music revealed the theme song artists for Reborn as a Space Mercenary , the television anime of Ryūto and Tetsuhiro Nabeshima 's Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Announces Home Video Releases for Look Back, Angel's Egg, More Films
content: GKIDS announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Sunday the following home video releases as GKIDS Store exclusives. GKIDS will release a 4K UHD Collector's Edition for the anime film of Fujimoto's " Look Back " one-shot manga on September 8.
author: ANN

title: Bleach to Continue With New Story After Thousand-Year Blood War (& Debuts New Characters)
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War might be ending Tite Kubo’s long running Bleach story with its fourth and final season later this month, but it’s now been revealed that Bleach ‘s story will be continuing after this final arc with new characters taking center stage of a surprising new project.
author: ComicBook
